main_text.p: זלתא Ch.Stilla. Item Decursus,defluxio. Plur.const. לקל זלחי מרחביך De sonitu defluxionū canalium tuo- rum, Psal.42.8.
זלל Ch.Vilem esse, vel haberi, vilipendi, vilescere, Levis, vilis, despectus haberi. Ithpahel אוזדלזל Idem. Pahel זלזל Vilipendere, contemnere, Deut. 27.16. in Jon.
זליל Ch.Commessator, epulo, Hebr. זולל, Deut.21.20. Plur.const. דמתחבר לזלילי Qui socius est commessatorum,Prov.28.7.
זלילא זליל Ch.Vilis, contemptus. Plur.זלילין. זילותא Ch.Vilitas, despectus, Thren.1.8.
זלע ולש Syr.Haurire. Imperat. ܙܠܥ Haurite adhuc, Joh.2.8.
זלוע,זלוע Ch. Lagena, 1.Reg.14.3. & Jerem.19.10. Hebr. יבקבוק.
זלף Ch.Stillare: Item Fundere, Hebr.זלף. Pahel זלף Stillare facere, fundere, effundere. Ithpah. אוזדלף Defluere, effluere, effundi, Jobi 20.28.
זלק זליקא Ch.Scintilla. Plur.const.זליקי Prov.16.27. Forte ab Hebraeo דלק Ardere, quod & Eliae placet.
זלוקפא Ch.Ingluvies, Vesicula gutturis in avibus, Lev. 1.16. in Jon. Idem quod זפקא.

זמה Ch. Hinc formam habet ויזמון יתיה Et multa-bunt eum, Hebr. וענשו אתו, Deut.22.19. in Jon. Scholiastes Hebraeus in hoc Targ.explicat, ויכחשו אתו Et mendace facient, vel mendacii convincent eum, puniendo viginti siclis, &c. juxta quam interpretationem, resset dagessandū ויזמון; deducit enim à זמם.

page.notes: Hebrew, Greek-free page; Chaldee and Syriac words are printed in Hebrew/Syriac characters, transcribed as far as legible. Some Hebrew forms in the Pahel/Ithpahel lines are approximate. The Syriac line "ܙܠܥ" and the faint Hebrew forms are doubtful. The signature "T 2" is at the foot.
